arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random
random.seed(99)
n = 12000
inputs2 = [[[3],[5]],[[7],[11]]]
states = [{"delivered": [[], [[7]]], "slots": []} for s in range(n)]
edges = []
seen = set()
for i in range(n):
    edges.append([i, "ring", (i+1) % n])
i = 0
while len(edges) < 60000:
    u = random.randrange(n); v = random.randrange(n)
    a = "ch%02d" % (i % 16); i += 1
    if (u,a,v) in seen: continue
    seen.add((u,a,v)); edges.append([u,a,v])
fair = [{"action": "ch%02d" % j, "mode": ("strong" if j % 2 else "weak")} for j in range(16)]
req = {"op":"audit","inputs":inputs2,"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,"fairness":fair}
open('dense_audit.json','w').write(json.dumps(req))
PYEOF
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, resource, os
data = open('/app/work/dense_audit.json','rb').read() + b"\n"
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    sys.stderr.write("child rc=%d outlen=%d\n" % (p.returncode, len(p.stdout)))
    open('/app/work/dense_out.json','wb').write(p.stdout)
    os._exit(0)
else:
    os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print("peak child RSS: %.1f MB" % (ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0))
out = json.loads(open('/app/work/dense_out.json','rb').read())
r = list(out.values())[0] if False else out
print("prefix len:", len(r["liveness"]["prefix"]), "loop len:", len(r["liveness"]["loop"]))
print("total ids:", len(r["liveness"]["prefix"]) + len(r["liveness"]["loop"]))
PYEOF
